2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to the NFS daemon (NFSD) that exercises its control plane from multiple namespaces simultaneously, testing the lock nesting and synchronization between namespaces. The test creates multiple namespaces, each with an NFSD server, and has them churn through various operations that interact with host-wide locks, including starting and stopping servers, emptying listener sets, and reading file caches. The test also includes synchronized rounds where all namespaces attempt to transition from a 0->1 state at the same time, which is only possible after per-namespace locking stopped serializing namespaces against each other. The test asserts that the kernel does not warn or produce any lockdep splats, and it logs a note if lockdep looks absent. The test is designed to catch issues with lock nesting, serialization, and refcount saturation.
